name: Dr3adful
noteEs: Dr3adful es uno de los content creators más prolíficos del cluster ARPG mainstream — cubre PoE 2, D4 y LE con cadencia high. Para Last Epoch específicamente publica builds detalladas por cycle, patch reactions rápidas y theorycrafts de mecánicas obscure. Bias hacia experimentación: no se queda con builds obvios, explora variants y mecánicas underused. Para players que quieren ver multiple takes editorial sobre el meta.
noteEn: Dr3adful is one of the most prolific content creators in the mainstream ARPG cluster — covers PoE 2, D4, and LE at high cadence. For Last Epoch specifically he publishes detailed per-cycle builds, fast patch reactions, and theorycrafts of obscure mechanics. Bias toward experimentation: doesn't settle on obvious builds, explores variants and underused mechanics. For players who want to see multiple editorial takes on the meta.
highlightsEs: Cobertura multi-ARPG (PoE 2, D4, LE) — útil si juegas varios
Foco en builds experimentales y mecánicas underused, no solo meta
Cadencia high de uploads, especialmente post-cycle launch
Patch analysis rápidos con take editorial fuerte
Linkea regularmente a Maxroll guides cuando complementa su content
highlightsEn: Multi-ARPG coverage (PoE 2, D4, LE) — useful if you play several
Focus on experimental builds and underused mechanics, not only meta
High upload cadence, especially post-cycle launch
Fast patch analysis with strong editorial take
Regularly links to Maxroll guides when complementing his content
